content: DEM practice: dt = t_coll/50 typical (MFiX default ratio 50, minimum 10). Linear spring contact time t_c = pi*sqrt(m_eff/k). TP4: pair m_eff=m/2 -> 3.51e-3 s; fixed obstacle/wall m_eff=m -> 4.97e-3 s. Local VV test: single-collision rel energy error 1.1e-1 @1e-3, 3.3e-4 @1e-4, 4.9e-6 @1e-5; explosion at dt>=3e-3.
